entries.subject: DAMIT 5525: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 5525, version 2019-10-23, pole (2°, 31°), period 8.7905 h, taken unchanged from the archive.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 147.066 ± 5.524 km, effective diameter of a sphere fitted to thermal infrared measurements. JPL lists a diameter of 147.066 ± 5.524 km, from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2014, ApJ 791, 121; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). The thermal sphere diameter is transferred to the mesh as its volume-equivalent diameter.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: Shown size Display reference radius "73.53 km (size-calibrated model)" (jpl-small-body-database) differs from the Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 285, DAMIT model 5525 diameter 165 ± 15 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 5525 fitted to 4 occultations); the shown value is kept.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.

entries.subject: Merapi whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 14 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.946 at 462 nm, 1.034 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#3f3e3b in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 4.8% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.5%), from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2014, ApJ 791, 121; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
